proposed_comments.title: Group shortcut collection tab navigation
proposed_comments.body:
### Group shortcut collection tab navigation

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `src/modules/ShortcutGuide/ShortcutGuide.Ui/Controls/ShortcutsPage.xaml`, specifically `MainItemsRepeater` and its surrounding `ScrollViewer`.

**Problem:** The shortcut items are now individually focusable, but the collection still exposes every item as a separate Tab stop. For manifests with many shortcuts, keyboard users must tab through the entire list before leaving it, even though arrow keys already provide within-list navigation.

**Why it matters:** A long shortcut manifest creates an unnecessarily long keyboard path and makes it difficult to leave the collection efficiently. The current `TabFocusNavigation="Once"` placement on `ScrollViewer` does not group the repeater's realized item controls, so the accessibility improvement still leaves the collection behaving as many Tab stops.

**Suggested change:**
1. In `src/modules/ShortcutGuide/ShortcutGuide.Ui/Controls/ShortcutsPage.xaml`, move `TabFocusNavigation="Once"` from the surrounding `ScrollViewer` to the `MainItemsRepeater` element.
2. Keep the shortcut item controls focusable and preserve their existing arrow-key navigation behavior; do not remove the item-level automation name or focus visual changes.
3. Verify that the `ScrollViewer` no longer carries the grouping property and that `MainItemsRepeater` is the single Tab-navigation group.

```xml
<ItemsRepeater x:Name="MainItemsRepeater" TabFocusNavigation="Once">
```

**Verification:**
1. Build `ShortcutGuide.Ui` in Debug x64 from the current upstream head.
2. Launch `<PowerToysCheckout>\x64\Debug\PowerToys.exe` and open Shortcut Guide.
3. Tab into the shortcut collection and confirm Tab enters and exits the collection as one group instead of stopping on every shortcut.
4. Use Down Arrow and Up Arrow inside the collection to confirm keyboard users can still move between shortcut cards, and verify each focused card retains its UI Automation name and system focus visual.
